nodes.description: WAD = 10 ** 18 scaling constant used for bid increase comparison in findAuctions.
RAY = 10 ** 27 scaling constant used to convert internal vat DAI to ERC20 DAI in extractVatDAI.
Immutable owner address of FlapperMassBid; source of MKR and recipient of extracted funds; used in access control checks.
Immutable Vow contract; supplies bump() lot size and flapper address.
Immutable Flap (surplus auction) contract; used to read bids/beg and to call tend.
Immutable DaiJoin contract; used for exit of vat DAI and derivation of dai/vat addresses.
Immutable DAI ERC20 token address.
Immutable Vat core contract; holds internal DAI balance of this contract.
Immutable MKR token used to pay auction bids; approved to flap.
Immutable Vow address stored in FlapperMassBidFactory for cloning.
Immutable DaiJoin address stored in FlapperMassBidFactory for cloning.
FlapperMassBid constructor: wires immutable protocol addresses and grants MKR approval plus vat hope.
View helper scanning flap auctions between indexes and selecting the cheapest bids up to maxAuctionsToBid.
Owner-only entry point: pulls MKR from owner and mass-tends the chosen flap auctions.
Owner-only: exits internal vat DAI to the owner as ERC20 DAI.
Owner-only: transfers any MKR held by the contract back to the owner.
Owner-only: transfers any ERC20 DAI held by the contract back to the owner.
Factory constructor storing the shared vow and daiJoin addresses.
Factory create(): deploys a new FlapperMassBid owned by msg.sender.
msg.sender: gate for all owner-only functions and the owner of factory-created instances.
block.timestamp: used to filter finished/expired auctions in findAuctions.
mkr.transferFrom(owner, this, bid * auctions.length) external token call inside execute.
flap.tend(auction, lot, bid) external call to the auction contract, wrapped in try/catch.
mkr.transfer(owner, balance) refund of remaining MKR at the end of execute.
daiJoin.exit(owner, vat.dai(this)/RAY) external call that converts internal vat DAI to ERC20.
mkr.transfer(owner, balance) external call in extractMKR.
dai.transfer(owner, balance) external call in extractDAI.
mkr.approve(flap, uint256 max) external call granting unlimited allowance in the constructor.
vat.hope(daiJoin) external call granting daiJoin operator rights in the constructor.
new FlapperMassBid(msg.sender, vow, daiJoin) deployment performed by the factory.
Constructor parameter _owner assigned to the immutable owner state variable.
Constructor parameter _vow cast to VowAbstract.
Constructor parameter _daiJoin cast to DaiJoinAbstract.
findAuctions parameter: first flap auction id scanned.
findAuctions parameter: last flap auction id scanned.
findAuctions parameter: maximum number of auctions to bid on; sizes the candidates array.
findAuctions parameter: per-auction MKR bid in wads; encoded into the returned data blob.
execute parameter: ABI-encoded (bid, auctions[]) blob produced by findAuctions.
Factory constructor parameter _vow stored as immutable vow.
Factory constructor parameter _daiJoin stored as immutable daiJoin.
findAuctions local: flap.beg() minimum bid increase factor.
findAuctions loop counter over auction indexes and later over candidates.
findAuctions local: memory array of AuctionCandidate structs holding the cheapest bids.
findAuctions local/return value: number of selected auction candidates.
findAuctions local: candidate with the largest bid, the replacement target when the buffer is full.
findAuctions inner loop counter scanning candidates for the largest bid.
findAuctions local: uint256 array of the chosen auction ids.
execute local: bid amount decoded from the data blob and passed to flap.tend.
execute local: decoded array of auction ids that are mass-bid.
execute local: lot size read from vow.bump() and used as the tend lot.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _owner is assigned to the immutable owner state variable and later controls all authorization checks.
Constructor parameter _vow is cast and stored in the vow state variable.
Constructor parameter _daiJoin is cast and stored in the daiJoin state variable.
Factory parameter _vow is stored in the factory vow state variable.
Factory parameter _daiJoin is stored in the factory daiJoin state variable.
The flap state variable is derived from vow.flapper() in the constructor.
The dai state variable is derived from daiJoin.dai().
The vat state variable is derived from daiJoin.vat().
The mkr state variable is derived from flap.gem().
The mkr token instance is the receiver of the approve call in the constructor.
The flap address is the spender granted unlimited allowance by mkr.approve.
The vat instance is the receiver of the hope call in the constructor.
The daiJoin address is granted operator rights via vat.hope.
beg is read from flap.beg() in findAuctions.
maxAuctionsToBid sizes the candidates array (new AuctionCandidate[](maxAuctionsToBid)).
startAuctionIndex initializes the auction scan counter i.
endAuctionIndex bounds the auction scan counter i.
Candidate entries are read out of candidates to find the largest bid candidate.
The largest bid candidate is written back into the candidates array when replaced.
Selected candidate auction ids are copied into the auctions result array.
numAuctions determines the length of the auctions result array.
mkrBidInWads is ABI-encoded into the data blob returned by findAuctions.
The auctions array is ABI-encoded into the data blob returned by findAuctions and later passed to execute.
The data blob produced by findAuctions is intended to be submitted to execute.
The bid amount is decoded from the untrusted data parameter inside execute.
The auction id array is decoded from the untrusted data parameter inside execute.
lot is read from vow.bump() inside execute.
The decoded bid is multiplied by auctions.length and passed to mkr.transferFrom.
auctions.length from untrusted data drives the bid * auctions.length MKR amount pulled from the owner.
The mkr token instance is the receiver of the transferFrom call in execute.
The owner address is the MKR source of the transferFrom call in execute.
lot from vow.bump() is passed as the tend lot argument.
The decoded bid is passed as the tend bid argument.
The decoded auction id array supplies the auction identifiers iterated for flap.tend.
The flap instance is the receiver of the tend calls in execute.
The mkr instance is the receiver of the residual MKR transfer in execute.
The owner address is the destination of the residual MKR transfer in execute.
The daiJoin instance is the receiver of the exit call in extractVatDAI.
The vat instance supplies the internal DAI balance exited in extractVatDAI.
The owner address is the recipient of the DAI exit in extractVatDAI.
The dai instance is the receiver of the transfer in extractDAI.
The owner address is the recipient of the DAI transfer in extractDAI.
The mkr instance is the receiver of the transfer in extractMKR.
The owner address is the recipient of the MKR transfer in extractMKR.
msg.sender is used as the owner argument passed to the newly deployed FlapperMassBid in create.
execute is gated by require(msg.sender == owner), which authorizes fund movement using the untrusted caller.
extractVatDAI is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
extractMKR is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
extractDAI is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
findAuctions decisions depend on block.timestamp when filtering finished and expired auctions.
mkr.transferFrom is executed within the execute function body.
flap.tend calls are executed within the execute function body.
The MKR pull from the owner precedes the loop of flap.tend bids in execute.
The residual MKR refund occurs after the flap.tend loop in execute.
daiJoin.exit is executed within extractVatDAI.
mkr.transfer is executed within extractMKR.
dai.transfer is executed within extractDAI.
mkr.approve is called in the FlapperMassBid constructor.
vat.hope is called in the FlapperMassBid constructor.
create performs the new FlapperMassBid deployment.
The deployment in create invokes the FlapperMassBid constructor.
The external MKR transferFrom call transfers control to an attacker-controlled token before bids are settled, allowing reentry into execute.
flap.tend is an external call inside the execute loop and can call back into the contract mid-iteration.
The trailing mkr.transfer refund is an external token call reachable while state from execute is still live.
daiJoin.exit performs external token/vat interaction during extractVatDAI.
mkr.transfer performs an external token call during extractMKR.
dai.transfer performs an external token call during extractDAI.

normalization_plan.reason: _owner is only used to initialize the owner immutable, so it normalizes into the constructor.
_vow is only used to initialize the vow immutable in the constructor.
_daiJoin is only used to initialize the daiJoin immutable in the constructor.
startAuctionIndex only bounds the scan loop inside findAuctions.
endAuctionIndex only bounds the scan loop inside findAuctions.
maxAuctionsToBid only sizes and bounds the candidate buffer in findAuctions.
mkrBidInWads is only used for filtering and encoding the result of findAuctions.
data is the sole input of execute and is decoded there.
_vow merely initializes the factory vow immutable.
_daiJoin merely initializes the factory daiJoin immutable.
beg is a short-lived caching local of flap.beg() used only in the findAuctions filter.
i is a loop counter confined to findAuctions.
candidates is the transient selection buffer of findAuctions.
numAuctions tracks the filled candidate slots within findAuctions.
largestBidCandidate is a temporary structure used for replacement inside findAuctions.
o is an inner loop counter used only in the findAuctions replacement search.
The auctions array is a temporary aggregation built and encoded in findAuctions.
The decoded bid directly determines the MKR amount moved by mkr.transferFrom in execute.
The decoded auctions array supplies the ids and count used by the flap.tend loop in execute.
lot from vow.bump() is passed straight into flap.tend as the lot argument.
